name: Maths Quest: Grade 5 End-of-Year Exam Scope
description: A 50-question interactive gamified Grade 5 Maths quiz covering Place Value, Rounding Off, Triangular Numbers, Time, Fractions, Laws of Arithmetic, Percentage & Decimals, Types of Triangles, 3D Shapes, Area & Perimeter, Data Handling, Missing Angles, Addition, Multiplication and Division. Every question is multiple choice, with a Grade 6 stretch tier, instant marking, badges and progress tracking.
